questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

**This idea, however startling it may at**

X-first appear, is quite in accordance, as 

Y-before stated, with the analogy of changes

Z-now going on in certain regions of the globe
questions.solution:
The first sentence segment makes it clear that the second sentence should be X since 'it may at first appear' makes perfect sense in the context of the sentence. The second sentence should be Y because putting Z after X makes the sentence without any meaning.

Therefore, the correct order would be XYZ.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

**There was no need to**

X-set a watch, for we had nothing 

Y-to fear from anybody or 

Z-anything in that vast untenanted plain
questions.solution:
The first sentence ends with 'to' which makes it evident that Y cannot be a possible option. Since Z makes the sentence grammatically incorrect, the second sentence should be X. As is evident from the sentence 'nothing to fear' makes sense in the current context and therefore the third sentence should be Y.

And by extension, the last sentence should be Z.

questions.question: Sub Sharan Africa has lost how many black rhino genetic lineages in 200 years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__44__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **From the line given in the passage:* ****Two centuries ago, the black rhinoceros – which roamed much of sub-Saharan Africa – had 64 different genetic lineages; but today only 20 of these lineages remain, says the paper. *
 
• Thus, from this line, it can be inferred that Sub Sharan Africa has (64-20) i.e. 44 black rhino genetic lineages in 200 years.\

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lineages: **direct descent from an ancestor; ancestry or pedigree

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice.**

He mailed his application for a new job.

options.text: The application for a new job is mailed by him.
The application for a new job was mailed by him.
He is the mailer of the application for a new job.
He was the mailer of the application for a new job.

questions.solution: Among the options, 3 and 4 change the meaning of the sentence and hence cannot be the possible answers. Option 1 uses the word 'is' instead of was and therefore cannot be the right answer. Which leaves only option 2 which is the right answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.**

Indiscreet
questions.solution:
The word 'indiscreet' means having, showing, or proceeding from too great a readiness to reveal things that should remain private or secret. The word 'careless' means not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoid harm or errors.

The other words mean:

Attentive - paying close attention to something. 

Choosy - taking excessive care when making a choice

Accurate - (especially of information, measurements, or predictions) correct in all details; exact.

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

"Ooh! what a dirty child!" said my aunt.

options.text: My aunt exclaimed disgustedly what a dirty child.
My aunt exclaimed disgustedly that the child is very dirty.
My aunt exclaimed disgustedly that the child was very dirty.
My aunt exclaimed disgustedly what a dirty child it is.

questions.solution: Option 1 is not the correct answer because it is an incomplete sentence. Option 2 is not the correct answer because it uses the word 'is' instead of 'was'. Option 4 is not correct because it refers to the child as 'it'. This leaves option 3 as the correct answer.

questions.question: Genetic diversity is proportional to _____________________.

options.text: The ability of a species to survive and reproduce

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The ability of a species to survive and reproduce**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **From the line given in the passage: ***Genetic variation is the cornerstone of evolution, without which there can be no natural selection, and** so a low genetic diversity decreases the ability of a species to survive** and reproduce, explains lead author Yoshan Moodley*
 
• Low genetic diversity means low ability of a species to survive, thus genetic diversity is proportional to the ability of a species to survive and reproduce.

questions.question: From the second half of the 20th century what has caused a dramatic fall in black rhinoceros population?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Poaching__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **From the line given in the passage: *****From the second half of the 20th century, however, poaching for horns has dramatically depleted their populatio**n and genetic diversity, especially in Kenya and Tanzania.*
 
• Thus, poaching is the main reason behind the dramatic fall in the black rhinoceros population.

questions.question: What is important for evolution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Genetic variation**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **From the line given in the passage: *****Genetic variation is the cornerstone of evolution**, without which there can be no natural selection, and so a low genetic diversity decreases the ability of a species to survive and reproduce, explains lead author Yoshan Moodley, Professor at the Department of Zoology, University of Venda in South Africa.*
 
• Thus, genetic variation is important for evolution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cornerstone: **an important quality or feature on which a particular thing depends or is based

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.**

Benediction
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Criticism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Benediction"** means a blessing or an expression of good wishes. (आशीर्वाद)

 
 
• **Example:** The priest gave a **benediction **at the end of the service.
 
 
 
• **"Criticism" **refers to the expression of disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes. (आलोचना)
 
 
• **Example:** The book received a lot of **criticism **for its controversial themes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'benediction'** is **'criticism'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Innovation **(नवाचार): The act or process of introducing new ideas, devices, or methods.

 
 
• **Example:** The company's success is due to its continuous **innovation**.
 
 
 
• **Beautitude **(परमानंद): Supreme blessedness or happiness.
 
 
• **Example:** Her face shone with **beautitude **as she held her newborn baby.
 
 
 
• **Approbation** (प्रशंसा): Approval or praise.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy received widespread **approbation **from the public.
